tasks.task_description: Navigate to https://example.com/form-demo, resize the browser window to 1280x720, and capture an accessibility snapshot of the page. Using the snapshot, locate a form with fields labeled 'Full Name', 'Email', 'Subscription Plan', and 'Newsletter Consent'. Fill in the form with the values: Full Name = 'Alex Rivera', Email = 'alex.rivera@example.com', Subscription Plan = 'Premium', and Newsletter Consent = true. After filling, press the Tab key twice to navigate within the form, then click the 'Submit' button. Wait for the confirmation message 'Thank you for signing up!' to appear. Once confirmed, retrieve all console messages at the 'info' level (including those from before navigation) and save them to 'console_output.txt'. Also, list all network requests made during the session that match the pattern '/api/submit', and extract the full response body of the first such request, saving it to 'response_body.json'. Finally, take a full-page screenshot in PNG format named 'confirmation.png' and close the browser tab.

tasks.task_description: You are given a Jupyter server environment. First, list all files in the root directory with a maximum depth of 2 to locate any notebook files (use pattern '*.ipynb'). From the results, identify a notebook named 'analysis_pipeline.ipynb'. If it exists, activate it using use_notebook in 'connect' mode. If it does not exist, create it at the root path 'analysis_pipeline.ipynb' using 'create' mode. Once activated, read the notebook in brief format (limit=50) to inspect its structure. If the notebook is empty or has fewer than 3 cells, insert three new code cells at the beginning: (1) a markdown cell titled '# Data Analysis Pipeline', (2) a code cell that prints 'Pipeline initialized on {current date}' (use Python's datetime.today().strftime('%Y-%m-%d')), and (3) a code cell that lists all available kernels using %lsmagic. Execute the second and third cells sequentially with a timeout of 60 seconds each. After execution, restart the notebook kernel to ensure a clean state. Finally, unuse the notebook and return a structured summary containing: (a) the full path of the notebook, (b) the number of cells after modification, (c) the output of the kernel listing cell, and (d) confirmation that the kernel was restarted.

tasks.task_description: Using the Neo4j database, first retrieve the full graph schema with a sample size of -1 to ensure completeness. Then, based on the schema, construct and execute a read query to find all 'User' nodes who created a 'Post' node in the past 7 days (relative to today). Finally, create a new 'DigestEmail' node for each such user, linked via a 'SCHEDULED_FOR' relationship to their respective posts, with a property 'scheduledDate' set to today's date. Return a structured list of user IDs and the count of posts they authored in the past 7 days.

tasks.task_description: You are tasked with creating a new collection named 'product_reviews_q3' to analyze customer feedback from the past 90 days. First, list all existing collections to ensure no naming conflict. Then, create the collection with fields: 'id' (primary key), 'review_text' (string), 'embedding' (768-dim vector), and 'timestamp' (string). Insert the following three review records: (1) {'review_text': 'Excellent battery life!', 'embedding': [0.1, 0.9, ..., 0.2], 'timestamp': '2024-06-15'}, (2) {'review_text': 'Poor screen quality.', 'embedding': [-0.3, 0.4, ..., -0.1], 'timestamp': '2024-07-02'}, (3) {'review_text': 'Great value for money.', 'embedding': [0.6, 0.5, ..., 0.7], 'timestamp': '2024-08-10'} — use placeholder vectors of length 768 filled with illustrative values (e.g., first vector: 0.1 at index 0, 0.9 at index 1, 0.2 at index 767, zeros elsewhere). After insertion, load the collection into memory. Next, perform a hybrid search using query text 'positive feedback about battery or value' with the same placeholder query vector as in record #1, searching over 'review_text' and 'embedding' fields, returning 'review_text' and 'timestamp' for top 2 results. Finally, output a JSON object containing the hybrid search results under the key 'top_positive_reviews'.
